messages:
anya: Heads-up — customer on dedicated saw what looks like a double charge after a reconnect + toolcall. Can paste logs below, short thread so we can triage quickly.

mike: thanks. can you attach session id + raw events?

anya: session id `sess_0e4f8c`. Sequence: router accepted stream, we did a soft snapshot at token 100 (client disconnected). Billing marked provisional for 100 tokens. Client reconnected and replayed the toolcall; router forwarded it as a new downstream request and billing confirmed ~90 tokens again.

anya: raw-ish snippets:
```
[router] recv stream_start sess=sess_0e4f8c user=acct_42
[runtime] soft_snapshot sess=sess_0e4f8c tokens=100 provisional=true
[billing] provisional credit acct_42 tokens=100 trace=tx_abc
[client] reconnect sess=sess_0e4f8c replay_toolcall toolcall_id=tool_77
[router] forward toolcall id=tool_77 new_request=req_333
[billing] confirm charge acct_42 tokens=90 trace=tx_def
```

kevin: so router turned the replay into a distinct request (req_333) because it didn't preserve the original toolcall identity. billing couldn't dedupe because request ids differ.

jess: question — is the duplicate token delta from truncation mismatch or the toolcall itself? looks like provisional 100 then final 90, so net should be 100 not 190.

anya: yes. The rough reason: the soft snapshot trimmed the stream and produced provisional charge. On reconnect we replay and the runtime executed the toolcall path again. Router didn't attach any idempotency metadata so billing saw two independent executions.

mike: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) billing-side dedupe by (acct, toolcall_id, timestamp-window) 2) router preserve `toolcall_id` -> forward as `x-toolcall-id` header 3) console mark provisional charges in UI so SRE can spot and refund. Thoughts?

jess: +1 to router preserving toolcall_id. Ideally client would emit an explicit idempotency key for toolcalls but we can't roll that client change across all customers quickly.

kevin: billing dedupe logic probably safest quick patch: if a confirmed charge arrives but there is an overlapping provisional charge for the same session and same toolcall_id within 2 minutes, don't double-charge; instead mark confirm and reduce provisional. Needs a clear audit trail.

billing-bot: created BILL-1234: "dedupe toolcall replay charges when provisional exists" assigned to @mike, priority P1.

sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-7890, tagged routing, billing, console.

anya: UX idea: Console ledger view shows provisional rows in orange with a hover explaining "provisional: session soft-snapshot; may be replaced by confirmed charge on reconnect". That would cut down on noisy refund requests.

mike: ops plan: implement router header passthrough > small runtime change to keep original `toolcall_id` -> 1 day. Billing dedupe rule -> 2-3 days (risk: edge dedupe false positives). Console provisional marker -> quick frontend patch 1 day.

jess: long term: require clients to send `x-infer-idempotency` for any toolcall; router must validate and forward. Billing dedupe then becomes deterministic and metric-friendly.

kevin: also add telemetry tag `replay=true` when router sees a reconnect replay; that will help query these cases in observability.

anya: will validate with the customer if they want a manual refund meanwhile. I'll add reproducible steps and the logs to BILL-1234.

mike: assign owners: router header patch -> @kevin; billing dedupe -> @mike; console marker -> @jess. Please add PR owners to the ticket.

jess: adding PR templates and a short acceptance test: replay a toolcall after soft-snapshot and assert billing_total == provisional_or_confirmed (not both).

kevin: ok will start router patch today. If anyone sees other similar reports ping here. :thumbsup:
